user.title: VoIP Stack
user.description: SIP softphone and SIP bridge/router for ESPHome VoIP phones. HA listens on SIP UDP and TCP automatically.

data.media_capture: Record private call audio for diagnostics
data.experimental_sip_video: Enable SIP video for the Home Assistant softphone

data_description.sip_port: Listen port for the HA SIP endpoint. HA accepts SIP signaling over both UDP and TCP on this port.
data_description.rtp_port: Base RTP UDP port for HA media and relays.
data_description.advertise_host: Optional override published in ESP phonebooks. Use this when HA is behind routing, NAT, LXC, VPN, or multiple subnets and the automatically announced address is not reachable by ESP devices.
data_description.assist_intents: Register optional Assist handlers for call, hang up, answer and decline ("Hey Jarvis, call Kitchen"). Spoken contact names are resolved dynamically against the live VoIP phonebook.
data_description.assist_endpoint_enabled: Add a SIP extension backed directly by a Home Assistant Assist pipeline. No separate VoIP integration or SIP listener is required.
data_description.debug_mode: Adds SIP, RTP and media diagnostics. Does not record call audio. To follow call routing, choose Enable debug logging on the VoIP Stack integration page.
data_description.media_capture: Explicitly records private call audio: up to 15 seconds per HA-softphone direction and 8 seconds per relay leg, stored as WAV/JSON in ~/.cache/voip_stack_debug (mode 0700) and pruned to 24 files / 64 MiB. Keep disabled unless collecting a diagnostic capture.
data_description.experimental_sip_video: Allow optional video for compatible endpoints and routes. Browser H.264, VP8 and JPEG require a secure context and a compatible browser. ESP support follows the configured device and codec profile: supported S3 display profiles receive JPEG; P4 profiles can use JPEG or H.264. Audio-only and camera-only profiles retain their respective limits.
data_description.sip_registrar_enabled: Accept REGISTER from local SIP endpoints such as VoIP phones, Zoiper, Linphone or baresip using accounts managed by VoIP Stack services.
data_description.trunk_enabled: Show provider/PBX trunk settings. When disabled, no trunk registration, external route or DTMF collector starts.
data_description.audio_codecs: Drag rows into preference order. Disable a row to exclude that codec while keeping its position. Keep at least one enabled audio codec. A call requires a codec supported by both endpoints.
data_description.video_codecs: Drag rows into preference order and enable the codecs this route may use. Clear the list or disable every row for audio-only calls. Video still requires compatible endpoints and an enabled video path.

video.title: SIP video
video.description: Video is optional and depends on the endpoint, route and configured codec. Supported S3 display profiles receive JPEG; P4 profiles can use JPEG or H.264. Browser and standard SIP video still require compatible peers, and a camera-only profile does not add video reception.

data_description.video_transcoding_enabled: Allow VoIP Stack to use Home Assistant's FFmpeg binary when two negotiated video legs have no direct codec match. Direct H.264, VP8 and JPEG remain preferred. The bounded fallback can convert legacy video for the HA softphone and H.264 or JPEG between HA-owned SIP legs. Browser JPEG send may also use one bounded RFC 2435 normalizer. Failure leaves compatible audio active.
data_description.video_camera_send_enabled: Expose a Send Camera choice in the card. Each logical Home Assistant phone keeps its choice; camera permission remains local to each browser. Receiving video never requires camera access.

assist.title: Voice assistant extension
assist.description: Choose the SIP extension and Home Assistant Assist pipeline used for telephone calls. When advanced call details are enabled, VoIP Stack starts the conversation with a user message such as `Incoming SIP call from "Daniele".` Configure telephone behavior in the selected conversation agent's own Instructions or prompt field under Settings > Devices & services > the agent integration > Configure. Example instructions: `When you receive a message beginning with "Incoming SIP call from", treat it as a live phone call. Greet the caller once, act as a concise receptionist, and do not repeat their name in every reply.` Friendly mood: `During SIP calls, sound cheerful and informal while remaining concise and helpful.` Terrible mood: `Hi. I don't give a s**t, so please go f**k yourself.`

default_trunk_missing.title: Choose the default outgoing SIP trunk
default_trunk_missing.description: No existing trunk is selected as the default. Open VoIP Stack, reconfigure the desired line and enable "Use as the default outgoing trunk". Alternatively, select a line in the phone options or call action. Deleting a line never silently selects another provider.

duplicate_extensions.title: Duplicate phone extensions
duplicate_extensions.description: These destinations use the same extension: {conflicts}. Assign a different extension to each phone, contact or Assist endpoint. Calls to an ambiguous extension are rejected; names and explicit SIP addresses remain available. For an ESPHome phone, change its extension on the device. This issue disappears when the phonebook has no conflicts.

parking_configuration.title: Parking configuration needs attention
parking_configuration.description: Choose valid parking access and slot numbers that do not conflict with existing phones, contacts or groups. Existing destinations remain unchanged.

mailbox_route_conflict.title: Voicemail feature codes conflict
mailbox_route_conflict.description: A phone, contact or group uses a voicemail feature address. Rename the conflicting destination; existing routes remain unchanged.

phone_service_unavailable.title: LDAP directory unavailable
phone_service_unavailable.description: The {service} listener on port {port} could not start. Check the address, port and certificate paths in LDAP directory settings, then save to retry. SIP continues to run and phones retain their previous directory.

esphome_account_firmware.title: Update the ESPHome phone firmware

esphome_account_name.title: Check the ESPHome SIP username
esphome_account_name.description: The ESPHome name selected for the SIP account on {phone} exceeds the supported length or contains unsupported characters. Update the name in the ESPHome configuration and reinstall the firmware.

esphome_account_name_collision.title: Choose a unique ESPHome SIP username
esphome_account_name_collision.description: The SIP username {username} selected for {phone} is already used by another phone or route. Choose a unique name in the ESPHome configuration and install the updated firmware.

esphome_endpoint_collision.title: ESPHome phone identity conflict
esphome_endpoint_collision.description: The ESPHome phone {phone} could not be restored because its {field} ({value}) is already owned by another phone. Other phones remain available. Open the device page to review its name or routing identity. No identifiers or credentials were changed.

group_membership_conflict.title: Group membership needs a configuration change
group_membership_conflict.description: These existing phone declarations overlap another configured destination: {groups}. Open VoIP Stack and correct the affected phone or group settings. Their existing declarations are retained until conversion can finish.

managed_record_invalid.title: Saved phone account needs recovery
managed_record_invalid.description: The saved account associated with {phone} is malformed. Its original data has been retained. Correct the native hardware association and account fields to retry without affecting healthy accounts.

account.title: Recover the saved SIP account
account.description: Choose its ESPHome hardware and correct its account fields. Leave the password empty to retain the saved credential, or provide a replacement when the saved credential is invalid.

error.migration_retry_failed: The saved account still cannot be recovered. Correct the reported fields and retry.

archive_record_invalid.title: Recording file needs recovery
archive_record_invalid.description: Recording file {filename} could not be read or references a missing WAV segment. Its files have been preserved. Restore the metadata and WAV files from a valid backup, then open the repair to select their SIP account and retry.

recording.title: Recover recording ownership
recording.description: Restore {filename} and its WAV segments before continuing. Select the account that owns this recording. Only this recording metadata is updated; audio files are preserved.

error.recording_recovery_failed: The recording is still invalid, missing a WAV segment, or busy. Restore its files and retry when recording has stopped.

directory_record_invalid.title: Directory configuration contains invalid records

name.description: Contact name. If ID is omitted, this is also used as the contact ID.

id.description: Optional stable ID. Defaults to Name.

address.name: Optional Address
address.description: Optional IP or host for a direct local SIP endpoint. Use with SIP Port and Transport when the contact is directly reachable.

sip_uri.name: Optional SIP URI
sip_uri.description: Optional complete SIP URI, for example sip:kitchen@192.168.1.50:5060;transport=udp. When omitted, HA resolves the contact by name, extension, registration or trunk number.

sip_profile.name: SIP compatibility profile
sip_profile.description: Auto keeps peer detection. Select Dahua for a static Dahua door station, without inventing a registration or User-Agent.

dahua_audio.name: Dahua audio compatibility
dahua_audio.description: Requires the Dahua profile for an explicit audio choice. PCM adds proprietary PCM/16000 to the offer. Symmetric also transmits with a validated received codec when negotiated for TX. Auto retains User-Agent detection.

extension.name: Optional Extension
extension.description: Optional local/internal dial-plan alias such as 101. Inbound DTMF and internal callers resolve this field before external numbers.

number.name: Optional Number
number.description: Optional external/public number used for trunk calls.

ha_bridge.name: Optional Bridge Via HA
ha_bridge.description: Force HA routing even when the contact has a direct SIP endpoint.

transport.name: Optional SIP Transport
transport.description: Optional signaling transport for a direct SIP endpoint. RTP remains UDP.

port.name: Optional SIP Port
port.description: Optional SIP signaling port for address-based contacts. Defaults to 5060.

rtp_port.name: Optional RTP Port
rtp_port.description: Optional RTP media port for direct local SIP endpoints. Defaults to 40000 when omitted.

tx_rate.name: Optional TX Rate
tx_rate.description: Optional manual TX sample-rate metadata. Use auto when omitted.

rx_rate.name: Optional RX Rate
rx_rate.description: Optional manual RX sample-rate metadata. Use auto when omitted.

tx_formats.name: Optional TX Formats
tx_formats.description: Optional TX RTP PCM format tokens, for example 16000:s16le:1:20.

rx_formats.name: Optional RX Formats
rx_formats.description: Optional RX RTP PCM format tokens, for example 48000:s16le:1:10.

max_payload_bytes.name: Optional Max RTP Payload Bytes
max_payload_bytes.description: Optional RTP PCM payload limit. Default is 1200 when omitted.

unavailable_to.description: Destination to try when this phone is offline. No rule is added unless configured.

ringing_timeout.name: Ringing timeout
ringing_timeout.description: Seconds before the no-answer action. Zero disables the limit. Omit to keep the current setting.

no_answer_action.name: When nobody answers
no_answer_action.description: Required when enabling a new ringing timeout. Choose hangup, forwarding or an enabled voicemail mailbox.

no_answer_to.description: Required phonebook destination or SIP URI for forwarding. For voicemail, choose a phone name or extension, or leave empty for this phone's mailbox.

send_video.name: Send video

rotate_phone_provisioning_token.description: Invalidate the old private download URL. Configure the new URL before the next phone download.

send_dtmf.name: Send keypad input
send_dtmf.description: Send digits on the current Automation call or a selected phone's established call, using its existing negotiated RTP or SIP INFO sender. Automation calls reuse the Text to Speech call context without a phone selector.

device_id.name: Phone
device_id.description: Select a phone for a normal call or manual execution. Omit for a native VoIP trigger or after Call with an Automation contact in the same execution.

digits.name: Digits
digits.description: Up to 32 digits: 0-9, A-D, star and hash, sent in order.

call_id.name: Call ID
call_id.description: Select one of multiple calls. For an explicit Automation call ID, also supply its generation. Native triggers and a single outgoing Automation call select both automatically.

expected_generation.name: Call generation
expected_generation.description: Reject a changed generation. Required with an explicit Automation call ID.

duration_ms.name: Press duration
duration_ms.description: Duration of each digit in milliseconds.

line_id.name: SIP line
line_id.description: Select a line when the physical phone has multiple SIP accounts.
